items.title: Running scalable hybrid quantum-classical workflows by integrating Amazon Braket with AWS Batch
items.summary: Practical quantum computing is hybrid: a quantum processing unit (QPU) executes a classically hard subroutine whose problem structure is amenable to quantum methods, while classical resources handle the surrounding computation. What varies across quantum algorithms is the workflow pattern: how the computation is distributed, what communication is needed, and how the data flows. Variational algorithms […]
